definitions.explanation: The person who receives something — money, goods, a document, or a benefit. A formal term used in administrative, legal, and business contexts. Built from {受領|じゅりょう} (receipt) + {者|しゃ} (person).

examples.japanese: {受領者|じゅりょうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{受領者|じゅりょうしゃ}⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手渡|てわた}された→手渡す：12757_tewatasu⟧。
examples.english: The documents were handed directly to the recipient in person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{補助金|ほじょきん}→補助金：19222_hojokin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受領者|じゅりょうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧{使|し}い{道|みち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}する→報告する：05644_houkokusuru⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Recipients of the subsidy are obligated to report how it was used each year.

notes:
A formal term for the party who receives something, common on official forms and in legal or financial documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受領者|じゅりょうしゃ}{名|めい}: recipient's name (as a form field)
- ⟦{補助金|ほじょきん}→補助金：19222_hojokin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受領者|じゅりょうしゃ}: recipient of a subsidy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{受取人|うけとりにん}→受取人：19162_uketorinin⟧: payee; addressee — the everyday word, especially for money or mail
- ⟦{差出人|さしだしにん}→差出人：06316_sashidashinin⟧: sender — the contrasting party who sends
